## Where it is

| Where | Path |
|---|---|
| Linux, macOS | `~/.config/gluon/config.yaml` |
| Windows | `%APPDATA%\gluon\config.yaml` |
| Anywhere | `GLUON_CONFIG` (a path; a relative one is taken from the directory you start Gluon in) wins; `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` (an absolute path; a relative one is ignored) moves the directory. routing.yaml and the saved keys (`.env`) live next to it. |

Gluon writes it for you (`gluon setup`, `gluon connect`); everything below can also be edited by hand. A file that isn't valid YAML stops Gluon with its path and line.

## Top-level keys

| Key | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `connections` | How each agent is connected: a subscription, or an API-key provider (OpenCode: several providers). |
| `bedrock` | The AWS profile and region every Amazon Bedrock use goes through. |
| `verified` | Written by Gluon: `harness/connection/model-id` → the date a check reached it. |
| `checked` | Written by Gluon: `harness/connection` → the date its models were last checked. |
| `unreached` | Written by Gluon: `harness/connection/model-id` → the date a check definitively failed to reach it (hidden from the offer). |
| `brain` | Where the intake agent runs: an ordered list of steps; the first working one is used. |
| `handoff` | What happens around an agent's session in Gluon's frame: its end, `/clear`, `/compact`, the home key and the mouse. |
| `cost` | Gluon's own cost figures. |
| `analytics` | `on` (default) records one row per launched session in `<state dir>/analytics.db`, queried with `gluon stats`; `off` stops recording. |
| `updates` | `auto` (default) installs a new Gluon release by itself at start, after checking its signature and checksum (it runs from the next start); `notify` only says one exists; `off` never checks. GitHub is asked once a day while Gluon is up to date, and at each start while a newer release is known. `GLUON_UPDATES` wins over it. |

A `models:` key from earlier versions is ignored: the model catalog is built in (see [Models](models.md)).

## connections

One entry per agent, under `connections.<agent>`:

| Agent | Connection |
|---|---|
| `claude-code` | `auth: subscription` (Claude plan), or `auth: api` with `provider`: `anthropic`, `bedrock`, `openrouter` |
| `codex` | `auth: subscription` (ChatGPT plan), or `auth: api` with `provider`: `openai`, `bedrock`, `openrouter` |
| `antigravity` | `auth: subscription` (Google account), or `auth: api` with `provider`: `gemini` |
| `grok-build` | `auth: subscription` (SuperGrok / X account), or `auth: api` with `provider`: `xai` |
| `opencode` | `providers`: a list of `openrouter`, `opencode-go` |
| `kimi-code` | `auth: subscription` (Kimi Code plan), or `auth: api` with `provider`: `moonshot`, `openrouter` |

## bedrock

`bedrock.profile` and `bedrock.region` set the AWS profile and region. Unset, Gluon uses `AWS_PROFILE`, then `AWS_REGION` or `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION`, then the `region` of the profile in your AWS config (`$AWS_CONFIG_FILE`, else `~/.aws/config`), then `us-east-1`.

## brain

`brain.order` is the list of steps the intake agent may run on; `brain.active` is the step in use (Gluon sets it). A step is `route`, `model` and optionally `effort` (`low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max`). The routes:

| Route | Where the intake agent runs |
|---|---|
| `claude-plan` | Your Claude plan, through the `claude` binary (Agent SDK). |
| `chatgpt-plan` | Your ChatGPT plan, through `codex app-server`. |
| `anthropic-api` | The Anthropic API with your key. |
| `openai-api` | The OpenAI API with your key. |
| `bedrock` | Amazon Bedrock, with your AWS profile and region. |
| `openrouter` | OpenRouter with your key. |

The default order:

| # | Route | Model | Effort |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `claude-plan` | `claude-sonnet-5-5` | default |
| 2 | `chatgpt-plan` | `gpt-6.1-sol` | default |
| 3 | `anthropic-api` | `claude-sonnet-5-5` | default |
| 4 | `openai-api` | `gpt-6-sol` | default |
| 5 | `bedrock` | `global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5` | default |
| 6 | `bedrock` | `us.openai.gpt-6-sol` | default |
| 7 | `openrouter` | `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5` | default |
| 8 | `openrouter` | `openai/gpt-6-sol` | default |
| 9 | `bedrock` | `us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6` | default |
| 10 | `openrouter` | `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6` | default |

## handoff

| Key | Default | Meaning | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `on_exit` | `return` | `return`: the session closes when the agent exits and the sessions home shows. `quit`: Gluon exits with the agent's code (the last session). | `return`, `quit` |
| `on_clear` | `ask` | `ask`: the agent's `/clear` asks whether to end the session. `stay`: the agent's own `/clear`. | `ask`, `stay` |
| `on_compact` | `ask` | `ask`: `/compact` (and auto-compaction where possible) asks whether to end the session instead. `stay`: the agent compacts. | `ask`, `stay` |
| `key` | `ctrl+\` | The key that opens the session menu from anywhere in the agent (←/→ switch; again: the sessions home). One of `ctrl+\`, `ctrl+]`, `ctrl+^`, `ctrl+_`. | a key name |
| `mouse_capture` | `true` | Clicks on the sessions home's rows; the wheel scrolls the home chat, and a session's frame when its agent doesn't use the mouse. `false`: never. | `true`, `false` |

Per-agent values go under `handoff.agents.<agent>` (`on_exit`, `on_clear`, `on_compact`, `key`) and win over the ones above. The section Gluon adds to an existing config file:

```yaml
# Agent sessions in Gluon. Per-agent values under `agents` (claude-code, codex, opencode,
# grok-build, antigravity, kimi-code) win, e.g.  agents: { codex: { on_clear: stay } }
handoff:
  on_exit: return  # return: the session closes when the agent exits, back to the sessions home | quit: Gluon exits with the agent's code (the last session)
  on_clear: ask    # ask: the agent's /clear asks whether to end the session | stay: the agent's own /clear
  on_compact: ask  # ask: /compact (and auto-compaction where possible) asks whether to end the session instead | stay: the agent compacts
  key: ctrl+\      # opens the session menu from anywhere in the agent: ←/→ switch, the key again shows the sessions home (or ctrl+], ctrl+^, ctrl+_)
  mouse_capture: true  # clicks on the sessions home's rows; the wheel scrolls the home chat, and a session's frame when its agent doesn't use the mouse (a drag over the home chat selects and copies text) | false: never
```

## cost

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `cost.audit` | `on` | `off` keeps no audit ledger on disk (the figures shown are unaffected). |
| `cost.antigravity_statusline` | `off` | `on` lets Gluon set Antigravity's status line, which is where its context comes from (Antigravity has no cost). |
